description: Read cached Yahoo analyst consensus revenue/EPS estimates and available EPS revision percentages for one exact Bullrun ticker. A free background refresh checks supported symbols on demand, storing at most one snapshot per day; the first read may be empty. Fiscal periods and source currency are preserved. The configured feed does not provide EBITDA estimates, management guidance or revenue revisions. Forward P/E/PEG context uses the latest annual consensus snapshot only when quote and EPS currency units match. Does not change portfolios or user data.

periodType.description: Return annual estimates, quarterly estimates, or both.

ticker.description: Bullrun ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "CRWD", "SPGI". Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.
